## Confidence and signal

HIGH and MEDIUM findings enter the review decision. Any P1 that is LOW goes to Needs investigation; the old wording "Any P1 | REQUEST_CHANGES" is gone.

## Review decision

| Findings | Decision |
|---|---|
| Any HIGH or MEDIUM P1 | REQUEST_CHANGES |
| Any HIGH or MEDIUM P2 | REQUEST_CHANGES |
| HIGH or MEDIUM P3 only | COMMENT |
| None, or LOW only | APPROVE |
